title: Corroboration Window From Facility Letters (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
In fixing the start date of a borrower's health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the **corroboration window** is:

- **240 days** where two or more facility letters are on file;
- **150 days** where exactly one facility letter is on file;
- **zero days** where none is.

A facility letter is an accepted supporting document on file about the monitored borrower (the profile's primary borrower), received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, on a plan whose supporting document setting is none. Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number.

## Basis Q&A

- *Does a letter received exactly 12 whole months before the handling date count?* No; it must be received less than 12 whole calendar months before.
- *Does a rejected supporting document count?* No; only accepted ones.
- *Hypothetical case.* Three accepted facility letters received within the last year give the same 240 days as two.
